cities.nearest_airport: John Paul II International Airport Kraków-Balice

places.name: Wawel Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic castle complex featuring stunning architecture, museums, and the resting place of Polish kings.

opening_hours.notes: Tickets can be purchased online.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Dragon’s Den and the Cathedral.

attribution.title: Wawel (4)
attribution.author: Monika Towiańska

places.name: Main Market Square
places.ai_summary: The largest medieval town square in Europe, surrounded by historic buildings, cafes, and the iconic St. Mary’s Basilica.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a horse-drawn carriage ride around the square.

attribution.title: Sukiennice and Main Market Square Krakow Poland
attribution.author: Jorge Lascar
attribution.description: Sukiennice and Main Market Square as seen from St. Mary's Basilica, Krakow, Poland

places.name: Cloth Hall
places.ai_summary: A Renaissance-era market hall in the Main Market Square, known for its beautiful architecture and souvenir shops.

opening_hours.notes: Shops inside have individual opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the upper floor for a great view of the square.

places.name: St. Mary’s Basilica
places.ai_summary: A stunning Gothic church in the Main Market Square, famous for its wooden altarpiece and trumpet signal.

opening_hours.notes: Climbing the tower requires an additional ticket.

places.place_tip: Listen for the trumpet signal from the tower.

attribution.title: Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore - Roma
attribution.author: NikonZ7II

places.name: Kazimierz (Jewish Quarter)
places.ai_summary: A historic district known for its Jewish heritage, vibrant nightlife, and cultural festivals.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot for the best experience.

places.place_tip: Visit the Old Synagogue and the Jewish Museum.

places.name: Schindler’s Factory Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum located in the former enamel factory of Oskar Schindler, showcasing the history of Kraków during WWII.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is highly recommended.

places.place_tip: Take the audio guide for a more in-depth experience.

places.name: Planty Park
places.ai_summary: A picturesque park encircling the Old Town, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Look for the statue of Adam Mickiewicz.

attribution.title: Planty Park, autumn, Old Town, Krakow, Poland
attribution.author: Zygmunt Put Zetpe0202
attribution.description: Planty Park, autumn, Old Town, Krakow, Poland

places.name: Floriańska Street
places.ai_summary: A historic street leading from the Main Market Square to the Floriańska Gate, lined with shops and cafes.

opening_hours.notes: Great for shopping and dining.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacy, obwarzanki, from a street vendor.

attribution.title: Floriańska street (view from N), Old Town, Krakow, Poland
attribution.author: Zygmunt Put
attribution.description: Floriańska street (view from N), Old Town, Kraków, Poland

places.name: Barbican of Kraków
places.ai_summary: A historic barbican and defensive tower, offering panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum inside for more historical context.

attribution.title: Barbican, Florian Gate and Planty Park, Basztowa Street, Old Town, Kraków, Poland
attribution.author: Jeremiah Z. Cockroach
attribution.description: Barbican, Florian Gate and Planty Park, Basztowa Street, Old Town, Kraków, Poland

places.name: Wieliczka Salt Mine
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, this salt mine features stunning underground chapels and sculptures.

opening_hours.notes: Tours must be booked in advance.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a jacket, it’s cool underground.

places.name: Tyniec Abbey
places.ai_summary: A beautiful Benedictine abbey located on a hill overlooking the Vistula River.

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Explore the walking trails around the abbey.

attribution.description: View from Okrążek rock in Piekary towards Vistula River, Tyniec Abbey (on the right) and Camaldolese Monastery (on the left)

places.name: Krakus Mound Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A historic mound offering panoramic views of Kraków and the Vistula River.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.name: Nowa Huta District
places.ai_summary: A district built in the 1940s as a socialist realist city, now a vibrant area with a unique atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot or by bike.

places.place_tip: Visit the Nowa Huta Museum for historical context.

attribution.title: Nowa Huta - Plac Centralny z lotu ptaka
attribution.author: Piotr Tomaszewski-Guillon / dronographyapplied.com
attribution.description: One of the most prominent examples of Socialist architecture in Poland. The embodiment of a perfect socialist city.

places.name: Rynek Underground Museum
places.ai_summary: An underground museum located beneath the Main Market Square, showcasing the history of Kraków.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Cloth Hall and St. Mary’s Basilica.

attribution.author: bazylek100 / Robin
attribution.description: The underground of the Main Square in Krakow, so-called the Rich Stalls.

places.name: Jagiellonian University Collegium Maius
places.ai_summary: The oldest building of the Jagiellonian University, featuring a beautiful courtyard and a museum.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum of the Jagiellonian University located here.
places.address: Jagiellonian University Collegium Maius, Kraków, Poland

places.name: Oskar Schindler’s Enamel Factory
places.ai_summary: A museum located in the former enamel factory of Oskar Schindler, telling the story of Kraków during the Nazi occupation.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is highly recommended.

places.place_tip: Take the audio guide for a more in-depth experience.
places.address: Oskar Schindler’s Enamel Factory, Kraków, Poland

places.name: St. Florian’s Gate
places.ai_summary: A historic city gate, part of the medieval fortifications of Kraków.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the outside.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Barbican and Planty Park.

places.name: National Museum in Kraków
places.ai_summary: The oldest museum in Poland, featuring a vast collection of art and historical artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions during your visit.
places.address: National Museum in Kraków, Kraków, Poland

places.name: Botanic Garden of the Jagiellonian University
places.ai_summary: A beautiful garden featuring a wide variety of plants, trees, and flowers, perfect for a peaceful walk.

places.place_tip: Visit the greenhouse for exotic plants.

places.ai_summary: A scenic walkway along the Vistula River, ideal for a relaxing walk or bike ride.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Look for the various species of birds along the way.
